C.S.C.

 Hon'Ble Prakash Padia, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel on behalf of respondents- State.
2.

The petitioner has preferred the present writ petition inter-alia with the prayer to direct the respondent no.2-Commissioner, Food, Safety and Drugs Administration, U.P., Lucknow to decide the stay application filed along-with appeal U/s 32-4(C) of Food, Safety and Standard Act, 2006 dated 24.09.2025 expeditiously.

entities.text: Food, Safety and Drugs Administration, U.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The food safety license of the petitioner was cancelled by the respondent no.3 namely Assistant Commissioner (Food, Safety and Drugs Administration), Mathura vide order dated 12.09.2025.
Aggrieved against the aforesaid statutory appeal was filed by the petitioner before the respondent no.2.
Along-with the said appeal application for grant of interim relief was also filed on 24.09.2025.
4. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that a considerable time has already lapsed but till date no decision has been taken on the same.
5. It is stated by Sri Hare Ram Tripathi, learned Standing Counsel that respondent no.2 will take a decision on the aforesaid application expeditiously.
6. With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the writ petition is being disposed of at the admission stage itself.

7. In the facts and circumstances of the case, present petition is disposed of with the direction to the respondent no.2 to take a decision on the aforesaid application most expeditiously and positively within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

(Prakash Padia,J.) November 13, 2025 Pramod Tripathi  M/S Piyush Refreshment Corner vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 13 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38524510/
